name: Kettlebell American Swing
steps: Stand slightly wider than shoulder width behind a kettlebell, hinge with a flat back, and grip the handle with both hands.
Hike the kettlebell high between your thighs, then drive your hips powerfully forward to launch it upward in a wide arc.
Guide the rising bell with straight arms all the way overhead until the bottom points toward the ceiling and your biceps frame your ears.
Let the kettlebell arc smoothly back down between your thighs, hinging at your hips just before your forearms meet your torso.
tips: Brace your abs and glutes tightly at the top so your lower back does not arch under the overhead bell.
Power the swing with a sharp hip snap rather than squatting downward or lifting the bell with your shoulders.
